Scandinavian Dining in Nha Trang
Jan 2026 • Friends
Being in Vietnam, the preference is always to enjoy the incredible local food, but every now and then it’s nice to try something different.

I’ve been to this bistro a few times now. While the service can be a bit hit-and-miss depending on how busy it is, the staff are consistently friendly and helpful. The ambience is pleasant and the menu is more than adequate.

The food is excellent, with the Hokubeef steak being a real standout. I always ask myself one question after a meal: would I return?
The answer is absolutely.
